subject.title: fix(llm): summarize ephemeral tool results to preserve prefix cache

question: Which tool-result visibility policy should this PR pursue for DeepSeek prefix-cache preservation?
rationale: The code can mechanically summarize tool outputs, but deciding which tool results may be hidden from future model turns is a product/runtime policy choice because broad redaction breaks normal agent workflows.

options.title: Narrow to low-value status results
options.body: Keep the provider rewrite only for heartbeat/status-style results whose payload is not needed for follow-up reasoning, then require live DeepSeek proof.

options.title: Use opt-in middleware or pruning
options.body: Route noisy command output through Tokenjuice/tool-result middleware or context pruning so users opt into compaction for data-bearing tools.

options.title: Pause for the broader cache strategy
options.body: Defer this PR while maintainers choose the canonical provider-cache strategy tracked by the related DeepSeek cache work.

recommendation.title: Narrow to low-value status results
recommendation.body: Keep the provider rewrite only for heartbeat/status-style results whose payload is not needed for follow-up reasoning, then require live DeepSeek proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision sits on provider prompt construction and prompt-cache behavior where Vincent has the strongest recent history signal.
